name: MBit Wireless Pvt. Ltd
india_angle: MBit Wireless Pvt. Ltd is based in India and focuses on developing semiconductor solutions for global markets.
summary: MBit Wireless Pvt. Ltd is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in the design and development of high-performance systems-on-chips (SoCs) and cellular IoT modem solutions. They collaborate with leading OEMs and Telcos to provide advanced connectivity solutions for mobile and IoT devices.
